citation.author: Shinichi Mochizuki
citation.title: Arithmetic Elliptic Curves in General Position
citation.quoteMarkdown:
(ii) (ABC Conjecture for $\Sigma$-Supported Compactly Bounded Subsets) Let $P\overset{\mathrm{def}}{=}\mathbb P^1_{\mathbb Q}$ be the projective line over $\mathbb Q$; $C\subseteq P$ the divisor consisting of the three points “0”, “1”, and “$\infty$”; $U_P\overset{\mathrm{def}}{=}P\setminus C$; $d$ a positive integer; $\epsilon\in\mathbb R_{>0}$ a positive real number; $\mathcal K_V\subseteq U_P(\overline{\mathbb Q})$ a compactly bounded subset [i.e., regarded as a subset of $P(\overline{\mathbb Q})$ — cf. Example 1.3, (ii)] whose support contains $\Sigma$. Write $\omega_P$ for the canonical sheaf on $P$. Then the inequality of BD-classes of functions

$$\mathrm{ht}_{\omega_P(C)}\lesssim(1+\epsilon)(\log\text{-}\mathrm{diff}_P+\log\text{-}\mathrm{cond}_C)$$

holds on $\mathcal K_V\cap U_P(\overline{\mathbb Q})^{\leq d}$.
